data.title: Speed challenge: an average that never crashes
story: Write a function safe_average(scores) that returns the average of the list.
If the list is empty, return 0 instead of crashing. Hidden tests also use zero and negative numbers.

explanation: First check whether the list is empty and return 0, then compute sum(scores) / len(scores). This guard at the start prevents a ZeroDivisionError without changing the result for normal lists.
hints: Average = total divided by how many items.
sum(list) adds up the list, len(list) counts its items.
Before dividing, check if len(scores) == 0: return 0.
